verdict.rationale: AMD's product page does include a genuine specs table (ECC support, NVMe RAID modes, supported OS) beyond marketing copy, but the evidence pack contains no actual clock speed, TDP/power, or AI TOPS figures with stated test conditions — most cited content is adjective-laden marketing (V-Cache hype, EXPO, PBO) rather than a rigorous spec sheet. The probe also shows the spec page itself is inaccessible to non-browser fetches, undermining easy comparison-shopping access. Missing for 10: explicit clock/boost frequency numbers, TDP/power figures, AI TOPS with documented test methodology, and confirmation that ordinary users (not just browsers) can reliably reach the full spec table.
